collection.description: A child sees a caterpillar and asks how it can become a butterfly.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) sees a caterpillar and asks how it can become a butterfly.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a naturalist, describes the stages of a butterfly's life.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) asks whether every insect changes the same way.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) watches leaves for signs of caterpillars.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) finds only empty leaves and tries again another day.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) mixes up the order and corrects it with help.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) tells a symbolic story as folklore.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) compares the tale with the actual stages.
